# L32.0 In-House Teaching Large Language Model

## Objective
Model, evaluation, and deployment: v0 open-source base model + course knowledge base retrieval + pedagogical prompting; v1 lightweight LoRA fine-tuning (Plan Stage 4). Liang Hu 10-16: "Yes, this large model is very useful, we want it."

## Current Status
In progress. **Stage 3 comparative experiment completed on 10-17 04:35**, results, reported to coordinating conversation; Stage 4 route pending decision by Liang Hu (recommendation: v0 gpt-oss-120b + retrieval + pedagogical prompting, developing task-routing in parallel; v1 LoRA waits for eval_v2).

## Decisions Made
- Plan v1: (agreed by Liang Hu).
- Freeze evaluation set before blind testing, no question modifications after testing; evaluation set excluded from training data.
- 10-17 Stage 3 settings and results: L32.0 Stage 3 Comparative Experiment Settings and Results 20261017
- Stage 4 first-round training <=50 CU, report to Liang Hu if exceeded; do not run or store >1 GB on local machine; store weights on CRC or the desktop workstation.

## Attempted and Results
| Date | Action Taken | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 10-17 | Stage 3: Qwen3-32B-AWQ, gpt-oss-120b (Colab A100 about 3.0 CU), Claude Sonnet 5.5, Gemini 3.8 Flash x bare / with BM25 course retrieval, answering eval_v1 100 questions; Opus primary grading, Gemini secondary grading (anonymized and shuffled, 800-script consistency r=0.92), Lead blind grading of 12 questions (96/96 within +-2 of Opus) | Total score (Opus): Claude rag 9.73 / bare 9.59, Gemini rag 9.39 / bare 9.19, gpt-oss rag 8.58 / bare 7.75, Qwen rag 7.88 / bare 6.92. gpt-oss rag is 1.15 lower than Claude rag (derivation -0.72, concept -2.1, discrimination -2.2); retrieval gain is +0.8 to 1.0 for local models, +0.1 to 0.2 for frontier models |
| 10-17 | Pre-freeze calibration of eval_v2 candidate version: Gemini 3.8 Flash bare answering 100 questions, single-grader scoring by Opus (re-grading v1 under same rubric yielded 9.21 for reference) | Full test 9.36 (concept 8.80 / derivation 9.53 / calculation 9.85 / discrimination 9.05), 64 questions >=9.5, none <=3; did not meet "frontier bare 7 to 9", derivation and calculation still near full marks |
| 10-17 | Pre-freeze calibration of hard test eval_v2h (derivation 15 / calculation 15), same rubric (Gemini bare, single-grader scoring by Opus), conducted once only | Full test 8.80 (derivation 8.67 / calculation 8.93), about 0.9 lower than same question types in v1 and v2; 11 questions >=9.5, none <=3; only 1 question had a numerical error, remaining deductions were for missing discussion or verification |
| 10-17 | Stage 3b (local version, revised per Liang Hu's instruction "focus on local models"): Qwen3-32B, gpt-oss-120b x bare/rag answering eval_v2 (100 questions) + eval_v2h (30 questions); local judge gpt-oss-120b grading in parallel against Opus reference, plus local judge re-grading eval_v1 for validation. Colab about 12.3 CU, exceeding 10 CU cap by about 2.3 (platform fault caused about 24 minutes of idle running) | Graded by Opus: eval_v2 gpt-oss rag 8.69 / bare 7.98, Qwen rag 7.78 / bare 6.70; eval_v2h gpt-oss rag 8.38 / bare 7.93, Qwen rag 6.68 / bare 6.33. Local judge is more lenient than Opus by +0.6 to 0.7 and biased toward local answers (own answers +1.05, frontier answers +0.2), compressing the gap between local and frontier to 0.33 (Opus is 1.15) -> cannot replace Opus, usable only for initial screening. Route unchanged |
| 10-18 | Stage 3c (L22 Strata node merged in, approved by Liang Hu on 10-18): Strata v0.1.45 + Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (G4, Drive cache, thinking off) x bare/rag answering eval_v2 + eval_v2h; Opus re-graded gpt-oss 3b answers in the same batch for paired comparison. G4 about 6.9 CU (00:25 to 01:12, auto-stopped upon completion) | Course test Qwen3.8 rag 9.01 / bare 8.65, gpt-oss 8.54 / 7.93 (rag +0.47 [0.14,0.81], bare +0.72); hard test 8.32 vs 8.30, tied; boot time 13.7 minutes, decoding about 142 tok/s, but requests queue up, making batch processing about 5x slower than gpt-oss/vLLM -> v0 base model switched to Qwen3.8, with gpt-oss as batch/concurrency backup |
| 10-24 | L32.0-10 Teaching Assistant v0: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (Strata, G4) + current course material retrieval 268 chunks + direct-answer prompt + thinking toggle; classroom prompt saved separately; gpt-oss-120b backup; graded by Opus | Course test 9.19 [8.96,9.40] (estimated about 9.42 with toggle, measured +0.45 on 52/83 routed questions), hard test with thinking on 9.15 [8.70,9.55] (off 8.02), both met targets; gpt-oss backup 8.53 / 8.60; single class session measured 69 minutes at about 10.3 CU; this task used about 19.4 CU, Opus $14.56; accidentally shut down one G4 (timer script error, fixed) |

## Pending and Next Steps
- 10-24 v0 delivered (L32.0-10): next step is classroom prompt v0.1 (strengthening hint-first behavior in English scenarios), and testing the remaining 31 routed questions before formal classes start; Liang Hu trial of one class session in Week 2 is about 10 CU.
- 10-18 after Stage 3c: v0 base model changed to Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (Strata, G4), with gpt-oss-120b as batch/concurrency backup (Decision).
- Stage 4 route submitted to Liang Hu for decision (via coordinating conversation). Original recommendation: v0 = gpt-oss-120b + retrieval (by knowledge point, prioritizing common errors) + pedagogical prompting; derivations/calculations handed to frontier models or computational tools for verification; v1 LoRA waits first for L32.1 to produce a harder eval_v2 (derivation and calculation questions are currently near full marks) and Liang Hu's lecture note corpus. Whether to train is to be decided by Liang Hu.
- Recommended v1 acceptance tolerance: eval_v2 derivation mean score within <=0.5 of frontier with retrieval, and number of questions scoring below 7 <=2x that of frontier (Section 7).
- Issues in eval_v1 questions recorded and handed over to L32.1.

- Literature clues pending verification (10-19, E2, second-hand summary unverified): three studies on GPT-4-assisted learning suggesting "tiered hints, not giving answers directly, and evaluating students by independent performance after leaving AI"; after launch plan approval, delegate to litwiki to verify original texts and build cards, then decide whether to incorporate into v0 pedagogical prompting and evaluation rubric. items.text:
# T13.1 开工与 CAARC 尺寸口径（10-17）

- 做了什么：Liang Hu 10-17 批 A9 后，T13.1 开工，派 cad 做"矩形建筑+计算域"参数化生成器。CAARC 1:200 默认按原文 ft 精确换算（0.1524×0.2286×0.9144 m），同时出取整版（0.15×0.225×0.90 m）；等 回答后确定主交哪套。
- 依据：Melbourne 1980 卡 L7ALGWJ5（journal p.74）标称 100×150×600 ft；取整版是 T28 需求写法，也是 CFD 线 1:400 算例的口径（本线数据，非文献）。
- 为什么两套都出：生成器多出一套只要几秒，避免对比数据口径不一时返工。
- 错了的代价：两套尺寸差约 1.6%，选错只影响与风洞数据对比时的尺度一致性，换一份参数表重出即可。

## 10-17 更新
- T28 回答：主版本改为 TFCA M4 风洞模型实际尺寸 0.15×0.225×0.90 m（CFD 线 MODEL_CARD.md 第 4、8 行），域用 M4 算例域；ft 精确版降为附件。派 cad T13.1-02 重出。理由：对比数据是 M4 风洞试验，模型尺寸以实物为准。代价：无，旧输出保留。

## 10-17 13:20 交付格式
- T28 试读（TACC 3608466）：分段 ASCII STL（solid <面名>）在 Fluent Meshing 中 11 个面名全认出 → T13→Fluent 的命名几何交付格式定为分段 ASCII STL + names.json；STEP 只作几何参考；Gmsh .msh 不给 Fluent。依据：本线数据（试读报告），无文献依据。代价：若日后要 STEP 带名，需改为按面分 body/part 输出再试读，属增量工作。
- 侧面：v2 生成器把两侧合成一个 STL 段 sides（全中心约定），names.json 里留 sides_neg/sides_pos 子标注；T28 表示两种都可。

## 10-17 下午 侧面命名改回 sides_neg / sides_pos（修订全中心约定）
- T28 终版试读（TACC 3608587）：两个同名 `solid sides` 段在 Fluent 里成为 sides 与 sides.1，不合并。改为唯一名 sides_neg（y-）/ sides_pos（y+），names.json 的 groups 保留 sides。全中心约定相应修订：域边界 inlet/outlet/top/sides_neg/sides_pos/ground（组名 sides）。依据：本线数据（试读报告），无文献依据。代价：R16.5 等若按单一 sides 写了 OpenFOAM 字典需改 patch 名或用组，属小改。
- T28 表示只改这一处即验收通过，不再做第三次试读。派 cad T13.1-03 出 v2c。

## 10-19 00:3x 补审
- 全中心命名/格式约定属"冻结交给别线的接口"，按规矩应先送审，当时未做；10-19 补发 （3 份）。裁决前约定照用（T28 已在用，改名成本小）。

items.title: T13 center-wide geometry interface convention · Review verdict (10-19)
items.text:
# T13 全中心几何接口约定 · 审查裁决（10-19）

审稿人：E·Gemini、A·GPT-6、D·GLM，3/3 有效，无补位。三位均"有保留地支持"。Lead 已在 generate_v2c.py 第 171–219、286–294、315–320 行，param_sources_v2.md 第 15 行， 的 groups 中逐条核实。依据均为本线数据，无文献依据。

## 必须改
1. **多栋 groups.building 混入底面**（E、A）：第 319 行只排除名字等于 'base' 的面，多栋时 bldg_xx_base 被收进去（two_buildings_v4 实测 12 个面）。改为从流体面取，并加每栋子组 bldg_<id>。
2. **旋转语义**（E、A、D）：现实现每栋绕自身中心自转，楼心不动（第 184 行），建筑群相对位置不随风向转。改为整群绕 rotation_center_m（默认原点=转盘中心）作刚体旋转；正方向为右手绕 +z（几何逆时针，等效来流顺时针转）。names.json 记录 rotation_center_m、旋转正方向、旋转前后的楼心坐标。
3. **"域不动"**（A）：domain_multipliers 分支按旋转后的包络重算域边界，风向变了域也变。改为按建筑群绕旋转中心的外接圆包络定边界，使同一组参数在所有风向下的域完全相同；domain_bounds_m 分支不变。
4. **面名语义与法向**（E、A、D）：windward/leeward/side_positive/side_negative/roof 定义为 0° 姿态下的局部轴面标签（x'−、x'+、y'+、y'−、z'+），θ≠0 时不代表实际迎风/背风。跨线传结构表面法向一律用 faces.building 的外法向。与风洞 Face I–IV 的对照表在 T13.4 补。
5. **缩尺字段**（E；A 认为可后补，D 列为参考）：采纳，因为成本低。names.json 加 geometry_scale（model|prototype）和数值 length_scale_factor；约定写明"坐标已是该尺度下的米，不得再次缩尺；STL 导入须显式设单位 m"。
6. **文档冲突**（E、A、D）：param_sources_v2.md 第 15 行仍写旧的 sides 统一命名。加勘误行，说明已被 v2c 替代，原文不删。
7. **约定文本与适用范围**（A、D）：写一页接口约定，内容包括：
 - 适用范围：CFD 表面几何交付；FEA（T13.3）、风洞加工（T13.4）另定。
 - 各线验证状态：目前只验证到 Fluent 2025 R2 表面网格，OpenFOAM、Ansys、风洞模型均未验证。
 - 映射责任：groups 只是元数据，由接收方建立 patch group（OpenFOAM inGroups）或 Fluent zone 和边界类型。
 - 命名规则：单栋用裸名（已交 T28 的保持不变）；多栋一律 bldg_<两位，01 起，取自参数表、跨版本不变>_<面>；底面 base 只存在于 building 文件，不属于流体边界。

## 仅供参考（随 T13.2–T13.4 后补）
- OpenFOAM 转换时按 names.json groups 自动注入 inGroups；.msh 恢复 sides 聚合组（T13.2）。
- 测点↔面对应表、建筑局部坐标↔世界坐标的变换（T13.2/T13.4）。
- 复杂几何改用二进制 STL 加 names.json 侧车的升级口。
- STEP 措辞改为"Fluent 这条导入路径不把面名映射为 zone"，不写"STEP 不带名"。
- Fluent 体网格连通和边界类型由 T28 在 CAARC 算例中闭环。

## 未采纳的异议
- D 称"OpenFOAM 边界文件无原生 group 概念"：不准确，boundary 文件支持 inGroups（A 引用了 OpenFOAM 手册 §5.3.6）。不影响第 7 条结论。
- A 认为现有缩尺记录已够：保留此意见。M4 尺寸确无重复缩尺，加字段只是为了让脚本能自动判断。

## 对已交付物的影响
已交 T28 的 CAARC M4 / Silsoe v2c 是单栋、0°、绝对域，不受第 1–3 条影响，不必重交。第 5 条的新字段在 v2d 补，届时以 --note 告知 T28。

## 落实（10-19 00:5x）
7 条必须改已由 cad T13.1-04 全部落实，Lead 核对通过：generate_v2d.py、outputs_v2d/、T13_几何接口约定_v1.md、param_sources_v2.md 第 17 行勘误。

# T13.2-02 LES v4 作业结果核查（10-24 20:31 EDT）

Decision I made：将 CRC 作业 1623225 的带建筑 LES v4 判为未通过，保留失败运行根，不交付为合格网格；因为 `checkMesh -allGeometry -allTopology` 的日志为 `Failed 1 mesh checks.`，而不是 `Mesh OK.`，退出码 0 不能代替质量判据。代价是 B 项仍需后续新运行根验证。

实验卡⑤已回填：，同内容同步至。建议负责对话在新运行根检查修订字典与最小行列式，再决定是否提交；提交前单独预检，批处理必须检查 `Mesh OK.` 字面后才报成功。此处仅判断本配置网格质量，不做科学结论。

items.text:
# T13.2 LES 网格："0 低行列式"判据与"入口同 R1"冲突（10-24 22:xx；Liang Hu 10-26 批 A227 ①）

- **事实**（子项目 T13.2-04 停止报告：；定位文件，已核）：
 - 按 R16.5 R1 生产网格的 blockMeshDict（sha …）在 CRC 复现了两套网格（作业 1623413、1623439）：空风洞 11,768,640 单元，带建筑 11,696,640 单元。
 - 两套网格各有 9,670 个行列式 <0.001 的单元（占 0.08%，最小 5.03e-5）；非正交为 0，凹单元检查 OK。
 - 这些单元全部在远场：贴地首层的扁平格，以及域侧边和顶角的长条格；近楼 0.0075 m 均匀区里一个也没有。
 - R16.5 已经用这套 R1 网格跑完生产。
- **冲突**：
 - A116 批准的方案目标写有"无低行列式"，这条判据属于 Liang Hu 批过的闸门，Lead 不能自己放宽。
 - R16.5 要求入口面与 R1 一致，以便复用已生成的入口湍流序列。
 - 两者不能兼顾：要消除这些扁平格，只能改外段 y/z 分级，而这会改变入口面。
- **选项**：
 - ① 对这两套网格书面例外放行（只限远场低行列式，网格与 R1 生产网格一致）。先例：R16.5 Silsoe snappy 网格有 41,372 个凹单元，书面放行。
 - ② 改外段分级做到 0 低行列式，R16.5 要重新生成入口湍流序列（代价由 T13.2-05 试算）。
 - ③ 两套都交，由 R16.5 选。
- **Lead 建议**：①。理由：这是 R16.5 已跑通生产的同一套网格，坏单元只在远场，不在测点附近。
 - 无文献依据，基于本线数据；OpenFOAM 的 det<0.001 是经验阈值。
- **在等 Liang Hu 期间（可撤回的部分）**：T13.2-05 继续做测点表、相邻比、入口逐点比对，并试算选项②的代价；网格暂不交 R16.5。
- 平台已登记 A227（不急）。T13.2-05 选项②代价试算回来后补进本记录；若批①，例外范围写明：仅限这两套 R1 复现网格、低行列式单元只在远场。

## 10-24 23:xx 补：选项代价（子项目 T13.2-05 回报，已核）
- **选项①**：可以立即交付。R1 带建筑网格（11,696,640 单元）的 319 测点↔面表已出。
 - 104 个测点唯一落在一个面上；215 个落在 0.0075 m 格线上，两面并列，按最小面号归属；0 个未匹配。
 - 实测最大相邻格宽比：x 1.041、y 1.056、z 1.055，均 ≤1.3。
 - 网格由与 R1 同一 sha 的 blockMeshDict 生成，入口面与 R1 一致。cad 先前报的"入口偏差 0.02 m"是它自己复算时公式用错，不是网格的问题；子项目已复算确认，T13.2-06 改正后重测。
- **选项②（备选 B，0 低行列式）**：首版设计约 21,573,000 单元，约为 R1 的 1.8 倍。
 - 入口节点：y 由 209 增到 271，z 由 206 增到 236。R16.5 必须重新生成入口湍流序列。
 - 实际低行列式数还没测到：作业因 CRC /users 写满没有跑完，T13.2-06 改在 /groups 重跑后给出实测值。
- Lead 建议不变：①。

## 10-25 补：选项②实测（子项目回报）
- R1 两套网格的入口与 R1 的偏差不超过 5e-10 m，入口一致已确认。
- 备选 B（21,573,000 单元）实测仍有 560 个低行列式单元，未达标。
- 约 2700 万单元一版（CRC 作业 1623720）正在跑；这一版同样要改入口。结果出来后补到本节。
- 结论（限本配置）：在 blockMesh 结构网格上要做到 0 低行列式，单元数至少翻倍（≥1.8 倍），且 R16.5 要重新生成入口。Lead 建议仍为①。

## 10-25 补：选项②实测完成（汇总）
| 版本 | 单元数 | 与 R1 空风洞之比 | 低行列式单元 | checkMesh |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
| R1（选项①） | 11,768,640（带建筑 11,696,640） | 1.00 | 9,670 | Failed 1 |
| 05b（1623641） | 21,573,000 | 1.83 | 560 | Failed 1 |
| 06d（1623720） | 27,000,000 | 2.29 | 82 | Failed 1 |
| 05c（1623724，空风洞） | 34,980,000 | 2.97 | 0（min det 0.00219） | Mesh OK |
- **选项②的代价**：单元数约为 R1 的 3 倍（34,980,000 / 11,768,640 = 2.97），LES 每步计算量随之约增 3 倍。
 - 入口节点 y 由 209 增到 331、z 由 206 增到 266，R16.5 必须重新生成入口湍流序列。
 - 近楼 0.0075 m 均匀区不变，只加密外段。
 - 只试了 3 版，没有证明这是代价最小的方案。
- **若选②**：还要再做带建筑版（约 3,491 万单元）、实测点距和测点表，约 2–3 个单核短作业。
- **Lead 建议仍为①**。依据：低行列式单元只出现在远场，R16.5 已在同一网格上跑通 R1 生产；无文献依据，基于本线数据。

## Liang Hu 10-26 批 A227 ①：书面例外记录
- **批复**：Liang Hu 10-26 在「待你处理」面板批 A227「同意建议」，即选项①。
- **例外范围**：仅限下面两套网格，不推广到别的网格。T13.2 其他网格仍按"0 个低行列式单元"验收。
 - 带建筑：，11,696,640 单元。
 - 空风洞：，11,768,640 单元。
 - 两套都由 R16.5 R1 生产网格的同一 blockMeshDict 生成（sha …）。
- **例外内容**：每套各有 9,670 个低行列式单元（det<0.001，占 0.08%，最小 5.03e-5），全部在远场：贴地首层的扁平格，以及侧边、顶角的长条格；近楼区 0 个。
 - checkMesh 的其余各项全部通过：非正交 0，凹单元 OK。
 - 实测最大相邻比 x 1.041 / y 1.056 / z 1.055。
 - 入口面与 R1 偏差 ≤5e-10 m。
- **依据**：R16.5 已在同一网格上跑完 R1 生产。要做到 0 个低行列式，需约 3,498 万单元（R1 的 2.97 倍），并且要重新生成入口。无文献依据，基于本线数据。
- **随交付的测点表**（R1 带建筑网格，319 测点）：（sha256 前 16 位 5c91c7d3828674b2），并列面另列在。统计：104 唯一、215 并列（取最小面号）、0 未匹配。
- **后续**：选项②的代价试算停止。05c（3,498 万单元）运行根留作对照，不交付。

reviews.text:
# T13 全中心几何接口约定 · 审查裁决（10-19）

审稿人：E·Gemini、A·GPT-6、D·GLM，3/3 有效，无补位。三位均"有保留地支持"。Lead 已在 generate_v2c.py 第 171–219、286–294、315–320 行，param_sources_v2.md 第 15 行， 的 groups 中逐条核实。依据均为本线数据，无文献依据。

## 必须改
1. **多栋 groups.building 混入底面**（E、A）：第 319 行只排除名字等于 'base' 的面，多栋时 bldg_xx_base 被收进去（two_buildings_v4 实测 12 个面）。改为从流体面取，并加每栋子组 bldg_<id>。
2. **旋转语义**（E、A、D）：现实现每栋绕自身中心自转，楼心不动（第 184 行），建筑群相对位置不随风向转。改为整群绕 rotation_center_m（默认原点=转盘中心）作刚体旋转；正方向为右手绕 +z（几何逆时针，等效来流顺时针转）。names.json 记录 rotation_center_m、旋转正方向、旋转前后的楼心坐标。
3. **"域不动"**（A）：domain_multipliers 分支按旋转后的包络重算域边界，风向变了域也变。改为按建筑群绕旋转中心的外接圆包络定边界，使同一组参数在所有风向下的域完全相同；domain_bounds_m 分支不变。
4. **面名语义与法向**（E、A、D）：windward/leeward/side_positive/side_negative/roof 定义为 0° 姿态下的局部轴面标签（x'−、x'+、y'+、y'−、z'+），θ≠0 时不代表实际迎风/背风。跨线传结构表面法向一律用 faces.building 的外法向。与风洞 Face I–IV 的对照表在 T13.4 补。
5. **缩尺字段**（E；A 认为可后补，D 列为参考）：采纳，因为成本低。names.json 加 geometry_scale（model|prototype）和数值 length_scale_factor；约定写明"坐标已是该尺度下的米，不得再次缩尺；STL 导入须显式设单位 m"。
6. **文档冲突**（E、A、D）：param_sources_v2.md 第 15 行仍写旧的 sides 统一命名。加勘误行，说明已被 v2c 替代，原文不删。
7. **约定文本与适用范围**（A、D）：写一页接口约定，内容包括：
 - 适用范围：CFD 表面几何交付；FEA（T13.3）、风洞加工（T13.4）另定。
 - 各线验证状态：目前只验证到 Fluent 2025 R2 表面网格，OpenFOAM、Ansys、风洞模型均未验证。
 - 映射责任：groups 只是元数据，由接收方建立 patch group（OpenFOAM inGroups）或 Fluent zone 和边界类型。
 - 命名规则：单栋用裸名（已交 T28 的保持不变）；多栋一律 bldg_<两位，01 起，取自参数表、跨版本不变>_<面>；底面 base 只存在于 building 文件，不属于流体边界。

## 仅供参考（随 T13.2–T13.4 后补）
- OpenFOAM 转换时按 names.json groups 自动注入 inGroups；.msh 恢复 sides 聚合组（T13.2）。
- 测点↔面对应表、建筑局部坐标↔世界坐标的变换（T13.2/T13.4）。
- 复杂几何改用二进制 STL 加 names.json 侧车的升级口。
- STEP 措辞改为"Fluent 这条导入路径不把面名映射为 zone"，不写"STEP 不带名"。
- Fluent 体网格连通和边界类型由 T28 在 CAARC 算例中闭环。

## 未采纳的异议
- D 称"OpenFOAM 边界文件无原生 group 概念"：不准确，boundary 文件支持 inGroups（A 引用了 OpenFOAM 手册 §5.3.6）。不影响第 7 条结论。
- A 认为现有缩尺记录已够：保留此意见。M4 尺寸确无重复缩尺，加字段只是为了让脚本能自动判断。

## 对已交付物的影响
已交 T28 的 CAARC M4 / Silsoe v2c 是单栋、0°、绝对域，不受第 1–3 条影响，不必重交。第 5 条的新字段在 v2d 补，届时以 --note 告知 T28。

## 落实（10-19 00:5x）
7 条必须改已由 cad T13.1-04 全部落实，Lead 核对通过：generate_v2d.py、outputs_v2d/、T13_几何接口约定_v1.md、param_sources_v2.md 第 17 行勘误。

# T13 Modeling and Meshing: Parametric Geometry and Mesh Tools (Active)

T13 was set up on 2026-10-16 because the PI judged that geometry and meshing matter for FEA and especially CFD, but the lab lacked good tools for them. The Lead agent surveyed tools and the needs of five user lines, found that scripted parametric geometry was the real gap, and split the work into T13.1 parametric geometry, T13.2 CFD meshes, T13.3 FEA meshes and T13.4 wind-tunnel model fabrication drawings. T13.1 built a generator that writes STEP and watertight STL files with named faces, and the CAARC 1:200 and Silsoe geometries passed the Fluent line's read-in test. T13.2 then built an OpenFOAM blockMesh generator: the CAARC RANS mesh (2,892,045 cells) and Silsoe mesh (503,280 cells) both passed checkMesh. A smoothed-grading CAARC mesh (2,591,745 cells) was judged "replaceable" by the CFD line, but only for one SST RANS configuration and a few force and pressure metrics. This was not a mesh-independence study. Two CAARC LES meshes that reproduce the CFD line's production grid were delivered under a written exception approved by the PI. T13.3 has a finalized task specification and waits for its development gate. T13.4 is paused.

## Timeline
- **2026-10-16**: The survey found blockMesh, snappyHexMesh and Ansys meshing tools on the cluster but no Gmsh, CadQuery or FreeCAD; the Lead agent proposed the order 13.1 → 13.2 → 13.3 → 13.4.
- **2026-10-17**: The PI approved the order. A dedicated environment was built, and the T13.1 generator passed its self-checks (maximum relative volume error about 1e-12, watertight STL). Domain sizes not found in the literature were labeled as assumptions.
- **2026-10-19**: Following the PI's center-wide instruction, all work paused and a pause summary and start-up plan were written. By then, the Fluent line had accepted the CAARC geometry, and the boundary-naming interface had been reviewed after the fact (3 reviews, 7 must-fix items resolved).
- **2026-10-22/23**: A citation-snowball search pooled 1,370 papers, and 7 were sent for literature cards. With the cards checked, the default 15H downstream distance was traced to the COST 732 guidance (cited secondhand) and kept. Two cell-type papers supported staying with hexahedral meshes, but they covered single buildings only and did not validate surface Cp.
- **2026-10-24**: The PI approved the plan: T13.2 started, T13.3 was limited to preparation, and T13.4 stayed paused. Same day, T13.2 met all three milestones, and its first LES mesh attempt failed with 266 low-determinant cells.
- **2026-10-24/25**: Matching the production inlet left 9,670 low-determinant cells (0.08%), all in the far field. Of three trial meshes, the only one with zero was an empty-tunnel version of about 34.98 million cells, about 3 times the production mesh, and it required a new inlet; it was not shown to be the cheapest option.
- **2026-10-26**: The PI accepted the exception. Both LES meshes and the 319-tap mapping table were delivered, and the CFD line read them in without format changes.

## What the PI decided
- The development order 13.1 → 13.2 → 13.3 → 13.4. The PI asked that the work focus on learning the tools and building "a usable library".
- On 2026-10-19, the PI ordered that any project without an approved plan stop, write a summary and resume only after approval.
- The PI approved the plan "as suggested except item five": start T13.2, prepare T13.3 only, and keep T13.4 paused.
- The PI approved the recommended option: a written exception for the two LES meshes. The exception record limits it to these two meshes, whose low-determinant cells are all in the far field; all other T13.2 meshes still need zero.

## Where it stands
T13.2 will not start new computation until the CFD line reports wall-resolution (y+) and inflow checks after its LES run resumes. T13.3 is due to open for development on 11-02 and must deliver demonstration panels to the Ansys line by 11-30. T13.4 waits for the wind-tunnel automation line to start.

# T13.1 参数化几何

脚本化（CadQuery/FreeCAD/Gmsh OCC）生成可复现几何，输出 STEP/STL + 边界命名表

# Daily Operations and Platform (Active)

In this root conversation the platform Lead agent reports platform operations to the PI and turns his rulings into actions across all lines. Between 2026-10-23 and 2026-10-28 the work was operational, not scientific: literature retrieval, the approval panel, review accounting, cluster storage and restructuring of project Leads. A paid reviewer model returned only a "balance insufficient" error, yet that error was counted as a valid opinion in 7 reviews since 10-21, so each of those reviews had 5 valid opinions instead of the 6 required. A guard against direct publisher PDF downloads turned out not to have loaded on 49 agents; it was confirmed loaded on 39 agents only after a restart on 10-26. The CRC home directory filled to 100% and caused one job failure, and CRC group space fell to about 220 GB free on the night of 10-25, before the PI-approved cleanups were carried out.

## Timeline
- **2026-10-23**: At the PI's request, "waiting for the PI" items were split into three kinds (approval needed, stuck awaiting the PI, suggested closure). Error-only reviewer replies now count as failures and trigger a substitute.
- **2026-10-24**: The PI approved 15 pending items in one batch. A request meant only for L31 was wrongly sent to all Leads (68 delegations), overloading the back end; 11 unfinished ones were withdrawn.
- **2026-10-24**: The CRC home directory reached 100%; moving one line's run directory brought it to 89%. After a further move approved by the PI on 10-25, home usage fell from 89 GB to 42 GB.
- **2026-10-25**: The PI asked that literature fetching be spread across three computers and authorised more Deep Research quota.
- **2026-10-25**: The PI set a new trigger: start active cleanup when CRC group space falls below 600 GB. He approved a first cleanup batch of about 822 GB; about 812 GB was actually deleted, leaving about 1010 GB free (10-26 02:17).
- **2026-10-25**: The PI asked for a project linking bluff-body aerodynamics to wind-engineering practice (L37); its start-up plan was approved on 10-26, literature only, no computation.
- **2026-10-26**: The 93 new Leads created on 10-25 for L31, L29 and R23 sub-projects were cut back after the PI decided single-conversation sub-projects should merge back; a cleanup list drawn up under his rule kept 20, and the platform Lead kept one more (L31.3) under his stated exception, 21 in all. At the PI's request L31.6 was then promoted to an independent Lead for its 14 topics; 12 existing sub-projects were transferred on 10-27 and the remaining two were still to be created.
- **2026-10-27**: The PI approved a second CRC cleanup (about 540 GB direct deletion, about 241 GB archived first, about 51 GB for the Fluent line); in a separate approval the same day he added 68 GB deleted and 72 GB archived for R23.3. The first tier actually removed 361.04 GB, while free space, with the other deletions running in parallel, rose from 522G (10-26 23:08) to 898G.
- **2026-10-28**: From the L22.8 method-evaluation recommendations, a traceability-table pilot and a rule-review process went to the PI; a warning for unverified numbers in delegation results was agreed as a two-week trial, to take effect after the next deployment.

## What the PI decided
- "Waiting for the PI" must list only items he has to approve or decide; suggested closures and stuck reports are listed separately.
- CRC cleanup is triggered when less than 600 GB of group space remains; literature fetching may use all three computers.
- Opened L37, merged single-conversation sub-projects back into their parents, and promoted L31.6 to its own Lead.

## Where it stands
Second-tier archiving to the desktop archive disk is still running, with CRC originals kept until checksums match. A request to the CRC administrators about a failed GPU node, a Deep Research credit top-up, the remaining workstation C-drive storage options and the L22.8 pilot are waiting for the PI.
